pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pAutomates the recipe family of a calculator inserted in its special slot.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Insert Basic, Scientific, Atomic or Flawless Calculator in the calculator slot.$p2. Supply that device’s required ingredients in the inputs.$p3. Provide the docking batch energy and output room.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pWith no recognized calculator installed, the recipe family is none. A charged device alone does not replace the station’s machine energy.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
